targets.title: Cooperation through image scoring in humans
targets.evidence_quote: In our laboratory, we chose to replicate the original WM [9] paper.
targets.outcome_quote: However, the replication was successful, despite our smaller sample size.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly call the replication successful overall, which takes precedence under rule 1. They also report that the lower-image-score discrimination finding was not replicated; without that overall verdict the comparisons would be mixed. Methodological limitations do not invalidate the central test in their assessment.

reasoning: New human participant data retest Wedekind and Milinski (2000). Other indirect-reciprocity studies and the agent-based model are background or sources of software, not independent retested targets. Target DOI is not printed in the extracted PDF and is left empty.
